name: caveman-agent
description: Open-source Caveman Agent SDK, Harness v4, Session Protocol, Evals, and React hooks.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/protocol build && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/harness build && pnpm --filter @caveman-ai/evals build
